-- [[ End Rscripts Risk Notice ]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local SESSION_KEY = "__EnemyManager_AutoTP_AutoSummon_V2"
local previous = rawget(_G, SESSION_KEY)
local saved = nil
if type(previous) == "table" then
    if type(previous.Snapshot) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(previous.Snapshot)
        if ok then saved = result end
    end
    if type(previous.Stop) == "function" then
        pcall(previous.Stop)
    end
end

local session = {running = true, connections = {}}
_G[SESSION_KEY] = session

local function listen(signal, callback)
    local connection = signal:Connect(function(...)
        if session.running then
            callback(...)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(session.connections, connection)
    return connection
end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local enemiesFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Enemies")
local remotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes")

local settings = {
    heightAbove = 0.2,
    teleportDistance = 6,
    followSpeed = 40,
    summonFirstDelay = 0.1,
    summonRetry = 0.1,
    releaseRetry = 1.5,
    summonRange = 22,
    resultTimeout = 3,
    linkTpTarget = true
}
local toggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.C

local SETTINGS_FIELDS = {
    {key = "heightAbove", name = "Height above target", min = 0, max = 25, fmt = "%.1f", tip = "Studs (your preset: 8)"},
    {key = "teleportDistance", name = "Teleport if farther than", min = 1, max = 100, fmt = "%.1f", tip = "Studs; otherwise follow"},
    {key = "followSpeed", name = "Close-range follow speed", min = 5, max = 100, fmt = "%.0f", tip = "Higher = faster"},
    {key = "summonFirstDelay", name = "First summon attempt delay", min = 0, max = 5, fmt = "%.2f", tip = "Seconds (your preset: 0.08)"},
    {key = "summonRetry", name = "Summon retry cooldown", min = 0.05, max = 5, fmt = "%.2f", tip = "Seconds after server response"},
    {key = "releaseRetry", name = "Release retry cooldown", min = 0.2, max = 5, fmt = "%.2f", tip = "Seconds between release requests; default 1.5"},
    {key = "summonRange", name = "Summon base range", min = 5, max = 100, fmt = "%.1f", tip = "Game default 22 + spirit-size allowance"},
    {key = "resultTimeout", name = "Summon response timeout", min = 1, max = 10, fmt = "%.1f", tip = "Retry if result event never arrives"}
}

local function parseKey(text)
    local wanted = tostring(text or ""):gsub("%s+", ""):lower()
    if wanted == "" then return nil end
    for _, key in ipairs(Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()) do
        if key ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and key.Name:lower() == wanted then
            return key
        end
    end
    return nil
end

if type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.settings) == "table" then
    for _, field in ipairs(SETTINGS_FIELDS) do
        local num = tonumber(saved.settings[field.key])
        if num and num == num then
            settings[field.key] = math.clamp(num, field.min, field.max)
        end
    end
    if type(saved.settings.linkTpTarget) == "boolean" then
        settings.linkTpTarget = saved.settings.linkTpTarget
    end
    local parsed = parseKey(saved.settings.toggleKey)
    if parsed then toggleKey = parsed end
    if (saved.schemaVersion or 0) < 4 then
        settings.heightAbove = 1
        settings.summonRange = 22
    end
end

local whitelist = (type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.whitelist) == "table")
    and saved.whitelist or {}
local selectedLandName = type(saved) == "table" and saved.selectedLandName or nil
local selectedLand = nil
local autoTP, autoSummon, autoRelease, autoTarget = false, false, false, false
local autoTargetFromTP = false
local setAutoTP
local currentEnemy, currentSpirit = nil, nil
local manualTarget = nil
local automaticTarget = nil
local lastTargetSent = nil
local lastAutoTargetSent, lastAutoTargetSentAt = nil, -math.huge
local pickManualTarget = false
local spirits = {}
local lastGlobalAttempt = -math.huge
local runningStatus = "Choose a land and whitelist enemy types"
local gui

local COORDS_FILE = "EnemyManager_LandCoordinates_v1.json"
local COORDS_CACHE_KEY = "__EnemyManager_LandCoordinates_v1"
local landCoords = {}
local pendingServerWrites = {}
local coordRemote = nil
local render

local function cleanPoint(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return nil end
    local x = tonumber(value.x or value.X or value[1])
    local y = tonumber(value.y or value.Y or value[2])
    local z = tonumber(value.z or value.Z or value[3])
    if not x or not y or not z then return nil end
    for _, n in ipairs({x, y, z}) do
        if n ~= n or math.abs(n) > 1000000 then return nil end
    end
    return {x = x, y = y, z = z}
end

local function loadPointTable(value, overwrite)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then return end
    for name, coords in pairs(value) do
        if type(name) == "string" and #name > 0 and #name <= 100 then
            local clean = cleanPoint(coords)
            if clean and (overwrite or not landCoords[name]) then
                landCoords[name] = clean
            end
        end
    end
end

if type(readfile) == "function" then
    local ok, json = pcall(readfile, COORDS_FILE)
    if ok and type(json) == "string" then
        local decodedOk, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(json) end)
        if decodedOk and type(decoded) == "table" then
            loadPointTable(decoded.points or decoded, true)
            if type(decoded.preferences) == "table"
                and type(decoded.preferences.linkTpTarget) == "boolean"
                and not (type(saved) == "table" and type(saved.settings) == "table") then
                settings.linkTpTarget = decoded.preferences.linkTpTarget
            end
        end
    end
end
loadPointTable(rawget(_G, COORDS_CACHE_KEY), true)
if type(saved) == "table" then loadPointTable(saved.landCoords, true) end
_G[COORDS_CACHE_KEY] = landCoords

local function saveCoordinateDisk()
    _G[COORDS_CACHE_KEY] = landCoords
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        writefile(COORDS_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({
            version = 1, points = landCoords,
            preferences = {linkTpTarget = settings.linkTpTarget}
        }))
    end)
    return ok
end

local function saveCoordinateForLand(name, point)
    landCoords[name] = point
    pendingServerWrites[name] = true
    local diskSaved = saveCoordinateDisk()
    local serverAvailable = coordRemote and coordRemote:IsA("RemoteFunction")
    if serverAvailable then
        task.spawn(function()
            local ok, accepted = pcall(function()
                return coordRemote:InvokeServer("Save", name, point)
            end)
            if session.running and (not ok or not accepted) then
                warn("Enemy Manager: server coordinate save failed for", name)
            end
        end)
    end
    return diskSaved, serverAvailable
end

task.spawn(function()
    local candidate = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("EnemyManagerLandCoordsRemote", 6)
    if not session.running or not candidate or not candidate:IsA("RemoteFunction") then
        return
    end
    coordRemote = candidate
    local ok, savedPoints = pcall(function()
        return candidate:InvokeServer("Load")
    end)
    if ok and type(savedPoints) == "table" and session.running then
        for name, point in pairs(savedPoints) do
            if not pendingServerWrites[name] then
                loadPointTable({[name] = point}, true)
            end
        end
        saveCoordinateDisk()
        if render then render() end
    end
end)

local function snapshot()
    local whitelistCopy = {}
    for landName, names in pairs(whitelist) do
        whitelistCopy[landName] = {}
        for name, enabled in pairs(names) do
            if enabled then whitelistCopy[landName][name] = true end
        end
    end
    local settingsCopy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(settings) do settingsCopy[key] = value end
    settingsCopy.toggleKey = toggleKey.Name
    return {
        schemaVersion = 7,
        landCoords = landCoords,
        whitelist = whitelistCopy,
        settings = settingsCopy,
        selectedLandName = selectedLand and selectedLand.Name or selectedLandName
    }
end
session.Snapshot = snapshot

local function stop()
    if not session.running then return end
    session.running = false
    saveCoordinateDisk()
    autoTP, autoSummon, autoRelease, autoTarget = false, false, false, false
    currentEnemy, currentSpirit, manualTarget, automaticTarget = nil, nil, nil, nil
    pickManualTarget = false
    for _, connection in ipairs(session.connections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(session.connections)
    if gui then
        local oldGui = gui
        gui = nil
        oldGui:Destroy()
    end
    if rawget(_G, SESSION_KEY) == session then
        _G[SESSION_KEY] = nil
    end
end
session.Stop = stop

local priorGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("EnemyManagerGUI")
if priorGui then priorGui:Destroy() end

local C = {
    bg = Color3.fromRGB(16, 23, 34),
    panel = Color3.fromRGB(29, 41, 57),
    button = Color3.fromRGB(41, 55, 73),
    selected = Color3.fromRGB(36, 87, 163),
    green = Color3.fromRGB(32, 125, 90),
    red = Color3.fromRGB(140, 55, 55),
    text = Color3.fromRGB(241, 245, 249),
    muted = Color3.fromRGB(148, 163, 184)
}

local function new(class, parent, properties)
    local obj = Instance.new(class)
    for key, value in pairs(properties or {}) do obj[key] = value end
    obj.Parent = parent
    return obj
end

local function rounded(obj, radius)
    new("UICorner", obj, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 8)})
    return obj
end

local function remote(name)
    local item = remotes:FindFirstChild(name, true)
    if not item then item = remotes:WaitForChild(name, 5) end
    if item and item:IsA("RemoteEvent") then return item end
    warn("Enemy Manager: missing RemoteEvent", name)
    return nil
end

local setTargetRemote = remote("SetTarget")
local attemptRemote = remote("SummonAttempt")
local releaseRemote = remote("ReleaseSpirit")
local availableRemote = remote("SpiritAvailable")

    and resultRemote ~= nil and removedRemote ~= nil
local releaseSupported = releaseRemote ~= nil and availableRemote ~= nil
    and removedRemote ~= nil

local DEFAULT_ATTEMPTS = 3
local DEFAULT_SPIRIT_LIFETIME = 15
pcall(function()
    local shared = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
    local config = shared and shared:FindFirstChild("Config")
    local module = config and config:FindFirstChild("Summon")
    if module then
        local summoning = require(module)
        DEFAULT_ATTEMPTS = tonumber(summoning.Attempts) or DEFAULT_ATTEMPTS
        DEFAULT_SPIRIT_LIFETIME = tonumber(summoning.SpiritLifetime) or DEFAULT_SPIRIT_LIFETIME
        local range = tonumber(summoning.InteractRange)
        if range and (not saved or (saved.schemaVersion or 0) < 4) then
            settings.summonRange = math.clamp(range, 5, 100)
        end
    end
end)

gui = new("ScreenGui", playerGui, {
    Name = "EnemyManagerGUI", ResetOnSpawn = false,

})

local function getWhitelist(land)
    if not land then return nil end
    local name = typeof(land) == "Instance" and land.Name or land
    whitelist[name] = whitelist[name] or {}
    return whitelist[name]
end

local function playerRoot()
    local char = player.Character
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function modelRoot(model)
    if not model or not model.Parent then return nil end
    local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
    return root or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end

local function enemyEligible(model)
    if not model or not selectedLand or model.Parent ~= selectedLand then
        return false
    end
    if not getWhitelist(selectedLand)[model.Name] then return false end
    local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0 and modelRoot(model) ~= nil
end

local function normalize(name)
    if type(name) ~= "string" then return "" end
    return (name:match("^([^,]+)") or name):lower():gsub("%s+", "")
end

local function findSpiritModel(sp)
    if typeof(sp.model) == "Instance" and sp.model.Parent then
        return sp.model
    end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - (sp.lastModelLookup or -math.huge) < 0.25 then
        return nil
    end
    sp.lastModelLookup = now
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spirits")
    if folder then
        for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
            if child:GetAttribute("SpiritId") == sp.id then
                sp.model = child
                return child
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function spiritPosition(sp)
    if not sp then return nil end
    local model = findSpiritModel(sp)
    if model then
        if model:IsA("BasePart") then return model.Position end
        if model:IsA("Model") then
            local root = modelRoot(model)
            if root then return root.Position end
        end
    end
    local payload = sp.payload or {}
    return typeof(payload.Position) == "Vector3" and payload.Position or nil
end

local function spiritEligible(sp, forRelease)
    if not sp or not selectedLand then return false end
    local payload = sp.payload or {}
    if forRelease then
        if payload.FirstTame == true or payload.NoRelease == true then
            return false
        end
    elseif sp.blocked or (sp.attempts or 0) <= 0 then
        return false
    end
    if sp.expiresAt and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() >= sp.expiresAt then
        return false
    end
    if not spiritPosition(sp) then return false end
    if type(payload.Land) == "string" and payload.Land ~= selectedLand.Name then
        return false
    end
    local candidates = {payload.Species or "", payload.DisplayName or ""}
    if sp.model then table.insert(candidates, sp.model.Name) end
    for enemyName, enabled in pairs(getWhitelist(selectedLand)) do
        if enabled then
            for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
                if normalize(enemyName) == normalize(candidate) then return true end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local SPIRIT_SWITCH_MARGIN = 2
local function closestSpirit(root, forRelease)
    if not root then return nil end

    if currentSpirit and spiritEligible(currentSpirit, forRelease) then
        local now = os.clock()
        if (not forRelease and currentSpirit.waiting
                and now - (currentSpirit.lastSent or now) < settings.resultTimeout)
            or (forRelease and now < (currentSpirit.nextReleaseAt or 0)) then
            return currentSpirit
        end
    end

    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, sp in pairs(spirits) do
        if spiritEligible(sp, forRelease) then
            local pos = spiritPosition(sp)
            if pos then
                local dist = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if dist < bestDist then
                    best, bestDist = sp, dist
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if currentSpirit and best and currentSpirit ~= best
        and spiritEligible(currentSpirit, forRelease) then
        local currentPos = spiritPosition(currentSpirit)
        if currentPos
            and (root.Position - currentPos).Magnitude <= bestDist + SPIRIT_SWITCH_MARGIN then
            return currentSpirit
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function summonReach(sp)
    local model = findSpiritModel(sp)
    local radius = 0
    if model and model:IsA("Model") then
        local attrRadius = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("Radius"))
        if attrRadius and attrRadius > 0 then
            radius = attrRadius
        else
            local ok, _, size = pcall(function()
                return model:GetBoundingBox()
            end)
            if ok and size then
                radius = math.max(size.X, size.Z) * 0.5
            end
        end
    elseif model and model:IsA("BasePart") then
        radius = math.max(model.Size.X, model.Size.Z) * 0.5
    end
    return settings.summonRange + radius * 0.6
end

local function targetDestination(enemy)
    local root = modelRoot(enemy)
    return root and root.Position + Vector3.new(0, settings.heightAbove, 0) or nil
end

local function closestEnemy(root)
    if not selectedLand then return nil end
    local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
    for _, enemy in ipairs(selectedLand:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy:IsA("Model") and enemyEligible(enemy) then
            local pos = targetDestination(enemy)
            if pos then
                local distance = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if distance < bestDistance then
                    best, bestDistance = enemy, distance
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function liveEnemyAnywhere(enemy)
    if typeof(enemy) ~= "Instance" or not enemy:IsA("Model") then
        return false
    end
    local land = enemy.Parent
    if not land or land.Parent ~= enemiesFolder then return false end
    local hum = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0 and modelRoot(enemy) ~= nil
end

local function closestEnemyAnywhere(root)
    local best, bestDistance = nil, math.huge
    for _, land in ipairs(enemiesFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if land:IsA("Folder") then
            for _, enemy in ipairs(land:GetChildren()) do
                if liveEnemyAnywhere(enemy) then
                    local enemyRoot = modelRoot(enemy)
                    local distance = (root.Position - enemyRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < bestDistance then
                        best, bestDistance = enemy, distance
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function resolveEnemy(value)
    if typeof(value) == "Instance" then
        local obj = value
        while obj and obj ~= enemiesFolder do
            if obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Parent
                and obj.Parent.Parent == enemiesFolder then
                return obj
            end
            obj = obj.Parent
        end
    elseif type(value) == "table" then
        for _, field in ipairs({"Model", "Enemy", "Target", "target", "Instance"}) do
            local model = resolveEnemy(value[field])
            if model then return model end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function sendTarget(enemy, fromAuto)
    if not setTargetRemote or not liveEnemyAnywhere(enemy) then return false end
    if lastTargetSent == enemy then return true end
    lastTargetSent = enemy
    if fromAuto then
        lastAutoTargetSent = enemy
        lastAutoTargetSentAt = os.clock()
    end
    setTargetRemote:FireServer(enemy)
    return true
end

local function setManualPriority(candidate, alreadySent)
    local enemy = resolveEnemy(candidate)
    if not liveEnemyAnywhere(enemy) then return false end
    manualTarget = enemy
    automaticTarget = nil
    pickManualTarget = false
    if not alreadySent then
        lastTargetSent = nil
        sendTarget(enemy, false)
    else
        lastTargetSent = enemy
    end
    pickButton.Text = "Priority: " .. enemy.Name .. " (change)"
    pickButton.BackgroundColor3 = C.selected
    setStatus("Manual priority: " .. enemy.Name .. " (until defeated or changed)")
    return true
end

    local client = scripts and scripts:FindFirstChild("Client")
    local stateModule = client and client:FindFirstChild("ClientState")
    if not stateModule or not stateModule:IsA("ModuleScript") then return end
    local ok, state = pcall(require, stateModule)
    if not ok or type(state) ~= "table" or not session.running then return end
    local signal = state.TargetChanged
    if not signal and type(state.Signal) == "function" then
        local success, result = pcall(state.Signal, "TargetChanged")
        if success then signal = result end
    end
    if not signal then return end
    local connected, connection = pcall(function()
        return signal:Connect(function(...)
            if not session.running then return end
            for _, value in ipairs({...}) do
                local enemy = resolveEnemy(value)
                if liveEnemyAnywhere(enemy) then
                    if enemy ~= lastAutoTargetSent
                        or os.clock() - lastAutoTargetSentAt > 2 then
                        setManualPriority(enemy, true)
                    end
                    return
                end
            end
        end)
    end)
    if connected and connection then
        if session.running then
            table.insert(session.connections, connection)
        else
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
    end
end)

local function approxSummonDistance(rootPos, spiritPos)
    local dx = rootPos.X - spiritPos.X
    local dz = rootPos.Z - spiritPos.Z
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
end

local function moveFloating(root, destination, deltaTime)
    if not destination then return end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char.Parent or root.Parent ~= char then return end

    local offset = destination - root.Position
    local distance = offset.Magnitude
    if distance > 0.015 then
        local step
        if distance > settings.teleportDistance then
            step = offset
        else
            local t = math.clamp((deltaTime or 0.016) * settings.followSpeed, 0, 1)
            step = offset * (distance < 0.5 and 1 or t)
        end
        char:PivotTo(char:GetPivot() + step)
    end
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

        }), 5)
        local editLand = rounded(new("TextButton", row, {
            Position = UDim2.new(1, -27, 0.5, -13),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 26),
            BackgroundColor3 = C.panel, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "...", TextColor3 = C.muted,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12
        }), 5)
        selectLand.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not session.running then return end
            if folder ~= selectedLand then
                selectedLand = folder
                selectedLandName = folder.Name
                currentEnemy, currentSpirit = nil, nil
            end
            render()
        end)
        editLand.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if session.running then openCoordinateEditor(folder.Name) end
        end)
        tpLand.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if not session.running then return end
            local point = landCoords[folder.Name]
            if not point then
                openCoordinateEditor(folder.Name)
                setStatus("Set coordinates for " .. folder.Name .. " once to enable land TP")
                return
            end
            local root = playerRoot()
            local char = player.Character
            if not root or not char then
                setStatus("Character unavailable for teleport")
                return
            end
            local wasAutoTP = autoTP
            if autoTP and setAutoTP then setAutoTP(false) end
            local dest = Vector3.new(point.x, point.y, point.z)
            char:PivotTo(char:GetPivot() + (dest - root.Position))
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            selectedLand, selectedLandName = folder, folder.Name
            currentEnemy, currentSpirit = nil, nil
            render()
            setStatus("Teleported to " .. folder.Name
                .. (wasAutoTP and " (Auto TP turned OFF)" or ""))
        end)
    end
    if not selectedLand then
        setStatus("No land folders found in Workspace.Enemies")
        return
    end
    local counts, names = {}, {}
    for _, model in ipairs(selectedLand:GetChildren()) do
        if model:IsA("Model") then
            if not counts[model.Name] then
                counts[model.Name] = 0
                table.insert(names, model.Name)
            end
            counts[model.Name] += 1
        end
    end
    table.sort(names, function(a, b) return a:lower() < b:lower() end)
    local allowed = getWhitelist(selectedLand)
    for _, name in ipairs(names) do
        local checked = allowed[name] == true
        addButton(enemyList, (checked and "[X] " or "[ ] ")
            .. name .. " (" .. counts[name] .. ")", checked, function()
            allowed[name] = not checked
            if not enemyEligible(currentEnemy) then currentEnemy = nil end
            if not spiritEligible(currentSpirit, autoRelease) then currentSpirit = nil end
            render()
        end)
    end
    if #names == 0 then
        new("TextLabel", enemyList, {
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 45), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = "No enemies in this land",
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.muted
        })
    end
end

        autoTarget = false
        autoTargetFromTP = false
        automaticTarget = nil

end

listen(tpButton.MouseButton1Click, function()

listen(linkButton.MouseButton1Click, function()

    saveCoordinateDisk()
    updateToggleButtons()

listen(summonButton.MouseButton1Click, function()

listen(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, processed)

                    if automaticTarget then sendTarget(automaticTarget, true) end

local function relevantChange(obj)
    return (obj:IsA("Folder") and obj.Parent == enemiesFolder)
        or (obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Parent
            and obj.Parent.Parent == enemiesFolder)
end
listen(enemiesFolder.DescendantAdded, function(obj)
    if relevantChange(obj) then
        task.defer(function() if session.running then render() end end)
    end
end)
listen(enemiesFolder.DescendantRemoving, function(obj)
    if relevantChange(obj) then
        task.defer(function() if session.running then render() end end)
    end
end)

local function trySummon(sp)
    if not session.running or not autoSummon or not summonSupported then return false end
    if sp ~= currentSpirit or not spiritEligible(sp) then return false end
    local root = playerRoot()
    local pos = spiritPosition(sp)
    if not root or not pos then return false end
    if approxSummonDistance(root.Position, pos) > summonReach(sp) then return false end
    local now = os.clock()
    if sp.waiting then return false end
    if now < (sp.firstReadyAt or 0) then return false end
    if now < (sp.nextAllowedAt or 0) then return false end
    if now - lastGlobalAttempt < settings.summonRetry then
        return false
    end
    for _, other in pairs(spirits) do
        if other ~= sp and other.waiting then
            if now - (other.lastSent or now) < settings.resultTimeout then
                return false
            end
            other.waiting = false
            other.nextAllowedAt = now + settings.summonRetry
        end
    end
    sp.waiting = true
    sp.firstSent = true
    sp.lastSent = now
    lastGlobalAttempt = now
    attemptRemote:FireServer(sp.id)
    setStatus("Summoning " .. tostring(sp.payload.Species or sp.id)
        .. " | " .. tostring(sp.attempts) .. " tries")
    return true
end

local function tryRelease(sp)
    if not session.running or not autoRelease or not releaseSupported then return false end
    if sp ~= currentSpirit or not spiritEligible(sp, true) then return false end
    local root = playerRoot()
    local pos = spiritPosition(sp)
    if not root or not pos then return false end
    if approxSummonDistance(root.Position, pos) > summonReach(sp) then return false end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now < (sp.nextReleaseAt or 0) then return false end
    sp.nextReleaseAt = now + settings.releaseRetry
    releaseRemote:FireServer(sp.id)
    setStatus("Releasing " .. tostring(sp.payload.Species or sp.id)
        .. " | waiting for spirit to disappear")
    return true
end

if summonSupported or releaseSupported then
    listen(availableRemote.OnClientEvent, function(payload)
        if type(payload) ~= "table" or payload.SpiritId == nil then return end
        local id = payload.SpiritId
        local sp = spirits[id]
        if not sp then
            sp = {id = id, firstReadyAt = os.clock() + settings.summonFirstDelay}
        end
        sp.payload = payload
        if typeof(payload.Model) == "Instance" then sp.model = payload.Model end
        sp.attempts = tonumber(payload.AttemptsLeft) or sp.attempts or DEFAULT_ATTEMPTS
        sp.expiresAt = tonumber(payload.ExpiresAt) or sp.expiresAt
            or (workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                + (tonumber(payload.Lifetime) or DEFAULT_SPIRIT_LIFETIME))
        spirits[id] = sp
        if autoSummon or autoRelease then
            local root = playerRoot()
            if root then
                currentSpirit = closestSpirit(root, autoRelease)
            end
            if autoRelease then
                tryRelease(currentSpirit)
            else
                trySummon(currentSpirit)
            end
        end
    end)
    listen(removedRemote.OnClientEvent, function(id)
        spirits[id] = nil
        if currentSpirit and currentSpirit.id == id then currentSpirit = nil end
    end)
    if resultRemote then
    listen(resultRemote.OnClientEvent, function(result)
        if type(result) ~= "table" or result.SpiritId == nil then return end
        local sp = spirits[result.SpiritId]
        if not sp then return end
        sp.waiting = false
        local now = os.clock()
        local reason = result.Reason
        if reason == "Cooldown" then
            sp.nextAllowedAt = now + 1.5
        elseif reason == "Busy" then
            sp.nextAllowedAt = now + 0.3
        elseif reason == "TooFar" then
            sp.nextAllowedAt = now + 0.5
        else
            sp.nextAllowedAt = now + settings.summonRetry
        end
        if result.AttemptsLeft ~= nil then
            sp.attempts = tonumber(result.AttemptsLeft) or sp.attempts
        elseif reason == "Failed" or reason == "Resisted" then
            sp.attempts = math.max(0, (sp.attempts or 0) - 1)
        end
        if result.Success then
            spirits[result.SpiritId] = nil
            if currentSpirit == sp then currentSpirit = nil end
            setStatus("Summon succeeded: " .. tostring(result.SpiritId))
            return
        end
        if sp.attempts <= 0 or reason == "NoAttempts"
            or reason == "Expired" or reason == "Invalid"
            or reason == "NotEligible" or reason == "StorageFull" then
            sp.blocked = true
        end
        setStatus("Summon " .. tostring(sp.id) .. ": "
            .. tostring(reason or "Attempt complete") .. " | "
            .. tostring(sp.attempts) .. " left")
    end)
    end
end

local function seedSpiritFromModel(model)
    if not model or not model.Parent then return end
    local id = model:GetAttribute("SpiritId")
    local species = model:GetAttribute("Species")
    if id == nil or type(species) ~= "string" or species == "" then return end
    local sp = spirits[id]
    if not sp then
        sp = {
            id = id,
            payload = {SpiritId = id, Species = species},
            model = model,
            attempts = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("AttemptsLeft")) or DEFAULT_ATTEMPTS,
            firstReadyAt = os.clock() + settings.summonFirstDelay,
            expiresAt = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("ExpiresAt"))
                or (workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + DEFAULT_SPIRIT_LIFETIME)
        }
        spirits[id] = sp
    else
        sp.model = model
    end
end
local spiritFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spirits")
if spiritFolder then
    for _, child in ipairs(spiritFolder:GetChildren()) do
        seedSpiritFromModel(child)
    end
    listen(spiritFolder.ChildAdded, function(model)
        seedSpiritFromModel(model)
        task.defer(function()
            if not autoSummon and not autoRelease then return end
            local root = playerRoot()
            if root then
                currentSpirit = closestSpirit(root, autoRelease)
            end
            if autoRelease then
                tryRelease(currentSpirit)
            else
                trySummon(currentSpirit)
            end
        end)
    end)
end

render()
updateToggleButtons()

listen(RunService.Heartbeat, function(deltaTime)
    if not autoTP then return end
    local root = playerRoot()
    if not root or not selectedLand then return end

    if autoSummon or autoRelease then
        currentSpirit = closestSpirit(root, autoRelease)
    else
        currentSpirit = nil
    end

    local focus = (autoSummon or autoRelease)
        and spiritEligible(currentSpirit, autoRelease) and currentSpirit or nil
    if focus then
        local pos = spiritPosition(focus)
        if pos then
            currentEnemy = nil
            moveFloating(root, pos + Vector3.new(0, settings.heightAbove, 0), deltaTime)
            return
        end
    end

    if not enemyEligible(currentEnemy) then
        currentEnemy = closestEnemy(root)
    end
    local goal = currentEnemy and targetDestination(currentEnemy) or nil
    if goal then moveFloating(root, goal, deltaTime) end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while session.running and gui and gui.Parent do
        local root = playerRoot()
        if not root then
            if autoTP or autoSummon or autoRelease then setStatus("Waiting for character...") end
            task.wait(0.05)
            continue
        end

        if (autoSummon or autoRelease) and selectedLand then
            currentSpirit = closestSpirit(root, autoRelease)
        elseif not autoSummon and not autoRelease then
            currentSpirit = nil
        end

        if (autoSummon or autoRelease) and currentSpirit
            and spiritEligible(currentSpirit, autoRelease) then
            local sp = currentSpirit
            local pos = spiritPosition(sp)
            local distance = pos and approxSummonDistance(root.Position, pos) or math.huge
            local reach = summonReach(sp)
            local now = os.clock()

            if autoSummon and sp.waiting
                and now - (sp.lastSent or now) >= settings.resultTimeout then
                sp.waiting = false
                sp.nextAllowedAt = now + settings.summonRetry
                setStatus("No summon response; retrying " .. tostring(sp.id))
            end

            if distance <= reach then
                if autoRelease then
                    tryRelease(sp)
                else
                    trySummon(sp)
                end
            else
                if autoTP then
                    setStatus("Approaching spirit " .. tostring(sp.id))
                else
                    setStatus("Move within approx. " .. string.format("%.1f", reach)
                        .. " studs of spirit " .. tostring(sp.id))
                end
            end
        elseif autoTP and currentEnemy and selectedLand then
            setStatus("Next enemy: " .. currentEnemy.Name .. " | " .. selectedLand.Name)
        elseif (autoTP or autoSummon or autoRelease) and selectedLand then
            setStatus("Waiting for whitelisted enemies or spirits...")
        end
        task.wait(0.02)
    end
end)

local Plrs = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Run = game:GetService("RunService")
local CG = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local SG = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local LP = Plrs.LocalPlayer
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

local getu = debug.getupvalues or getupvalues
local setu = debug.setupvalue or setupvalue

if not getu or not setu then
	pcall(SG.SetCore, SG, "SendNotification", {Title = "luhscripter", Text = "getupvalues unsupported", Duration = 4})
	return
end

local S = {
	Enabled = true,
	Auto = true,
	Delay = 0.05,
	Part = "Head",
	Chance = 100,
	Range = 1500,
	Players = true,
	Bots = true,
	Dummies = true,
	Box = true,
	Tracer = true,
	Health = true,
	Dist = true,
	TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 40),
	BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 48, 58),
}
getgenv().CleusSA = S

local t0 = os.clock()
while LP:GetAttribute("Shooter_Client_Loaded") ~= true and os.clock() - t0 < 40 do
	task.wait(0.1)
end

local Mods = RS:WaitForChild("Modules", 30)
if not Mods then return end

local function req(par, name, timeout)
	local inst = par:WaitForChild(name, timeout or 30)
	if not inst then return nil end
	local s = os.clock()
	while os.clock() - s < (timeout or 30) do
		local ok, res = pcall(require, inst)
		if ok then return res end
		task.wait(0.2)
	end
	return nil
end

local AutoShoot = req(Mods, "AutoShootModule")
local Crosshair = req(Mods, "CrosshairView", 15)
if not AutoShoot then return end

local Sync = RS:FindFirstChild("SystemResources")
	and RS.SystemResources:FindFirstChild("BufferCache")
	and RS.SystemResources.BufferCache:FindFirstChild("RequestActionSync")
if not Sync then
	Sync = RS:WaitForChild("SystemResources", 20)
		and RS.SystemResources:WaitForChild("BufferCache", 20)
		and RS.SystemResources.BufferCache:WaitForChild("RequestActionSync", 20)
end
if not Sync then return end

local FBullet = RS:FindFirstChild("Events")
	and RS.Events:FindFirstChild("RemoteEvents")
	and RS.Events.RemoteEvents:FindFirstChild("ReplicateFakeBullet")

local Shoot
for _, uv in pairs(getu(AutoShoot.OnShoot)) do
	if typeof(uv) == "function" then
		for _, i in pairs(getu(uv)) do
			if i == Sync then
				Shoot = uv
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if Shoot then break end
end
if not Shoot then
	pcall(SG.SetCore, SG, "SendNotification", {Title = "Cleus", Text = "shoot func not found", Duration = 4})
	return
end

local drawn = false
pcall(function()
	local l = Drawing.new("Line")
	l:Remove()
	drawn = true
end)

local hit = {position = Vector3.zero, instance = nil, model = nil, humanoid = nil, headshot = false}
local hits = {hit}

local origin = Vector3.zero
local bM, bP, bH, bPos, bScore
local lastPos
local bots, dummies

local function partOf(model)
	if S.Part == "Head" then
		return model:FindFirstChild("Head") or model:FindFirstChild("HeadHitbox")
			or model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end
	return model:FindFirstChild(S.Part) or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function scan(model)
	if not model or model == LP.Character or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
	if model:GetAttribute("CurrentHighlight") == "SpawnProtection" then return end
	local h = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if h and h.Health <= 0 then return end
	local p = partOf(model)
	if not p or not p:IsA("BasePart") then return end
	local pos = p.Position
	local dx, dy, dz = pos.X - origin.X, pos.Y - origin.Y, pos.Z - origin.Z
	local d = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz
	if d > S.Range * S.Range then return end
	if not bScore or d < bScore then
		bScore = d
		bM = model
		bP = p
		bH = h
		bPos = pos
	end
end

local function find(o)
	cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return false end
	origin = o
	bM, bP, bH, bPos, bScore = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
	local ranged = LP:GetAttribute("InShootingRange") == true

	if S.Players then
		for _, p in ipairs(Plrs:GetPlayers()) do
			if p ~= LP and p:GetAttribute("Deployed") ~= false then
				if ranged or p:GetAttribute("InShootingRange") == true then
					scan(p.Character)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if S.Bots then
		if not bots or not bots.Parent then bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("BotCharacters") end
		if bots then
			for _, m in ipairs(bots:GetChildren()) do
				if m:IsA("Model") then scan(m) end
			end
		end
	end
	if S.Dummies then
		if not dummies or not dummies.Parent then
			local sr = workspace:FindFirstChild("Shooting Range")
			dummies = sr and sr:FindFirstChild("Dummies") or nil
		end
		if dummies then
			for _, m in ipairs(dummies:GetChildren()) do
				if m:IsA("Model") then scan(m) end
			end
		end
	end
	return bM ~= nil
end

local function line(t, c)
	local l = Drawing.new("Line")
	l.Thickness = t
	l.Color = c
	l.Transparency = 1
	l.Visible = false
	return l
end

local tracers = {}

local function tracer(pos)
	if not drawn or not S.Tracer then return end
	local ok, l = pcall(line, 1.4, S.TracerColor)
	if not ok then return end
	table.insert(tracers, {l = l, p = pos, t = os.clock()})
end

local hlPool, hlHeld = {}, {}
local hlRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
hlRoot.Name = "esp_hl"
hlRoot.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or CG

local function highlight(model, on)
	local h = hlHeld[model]
	if on then
		if not h then
			h = table.remove(hlPool) or Instance.new("Highlight")
			h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 50)
			h.FillTransparency = 0.78
			h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 80)
			h.OutlineTransparency = 0.05
			h.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			h.Parent = hlRoot
			hlHeld[model] = h
		end
		h.Adornee = model
		h.Enabled = true
	elseif h then
		h.Enabled = false
		h.Adornee = nil
		hlHeld[model] = nil
		table.insert(hlPool, h)
	end
end

local ProxySync = {}
function ProxySync:FireServer(payload, ...)
	if S.Enabled and typeof(payload) == "table" and payload.origin and payload.direction and payload.hits then
		if S.Chance >= 100 or math.random(1, 100) <= S.Chance then
			if find(payload.origin) then
				payload.direction = (bPos - payload.origin).Unit
				payload.hitPosition = nil
				payload.hitInstance = nil
				hit.position = bPos
				hit.instance = bP
				hit.model = bM
				hit.humanoid = bH
				hit.headshot = bP.Name == "Head" or bP.Name == "HeadHitbox"
				payload.hits = hits
				lastPos = bPos
				tracer(bPos)
				if Crosshair and Crosshair.hitmarker then
					pcall(Crosshair.hitmarker, hit.headshot)
				end
			else
				lastPos = nil
			end
		end
	end
	return Sync:FireServer(payload, ...)
end

local ProxyBullet = {}
function ProxyBullet:FireServer(cf, vec, dist, ...)
	if S.Enabled and lastPos and typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
		local d = lastPos - cf.Position
		local m = d.Magnitude
		if m > 0.5 then
			vec = d / m
			dist = m
		end
	end
	if FBullet then
		return FBullet:FireServer(cf, vec, dist, ...)
	end
	return nil
end

local orig = {}
local ok = false
for i, uv in pairs(getu(Shoot)) do
	if uv == Sync then
		orig[i] = uv
		setu(Shoot, i, ProxySync)
		ok = true
	elseif uv == FBullet then
		orig[i] = uv
		setu(Shoot, i, ProxyBullet)
	end
end
if not ok then return end

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(S.Delay)
		if S.Enabled and S.Auto and Shoot then
			if not pcall(Shoot, AutoShoot) then pcall(Shoot) end
		end
	end
end)

local entries = {}

local function entry(model)
	local e = entries[model]
	if e then return e end
	e = {b = {}}
	for i = 1, 8 do e.b[i] = line(1, S.BoxColor) end
	e.hb = line(3, Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10))
	e.hf = line(3, Color3.fromRGB(70, 255, 130))
	if drawn then
		e.d = Drawing.new("Text")
		e.d.Size = 12
		e.d.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 225)
		e.d.Center = true
		e.d.Outline = true
		e.d.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		e.d.Visible = false
	end
	entries[model] = e
	return e
end

local function hide(e)
	for _, l in ipairs(e.b) do l.Visible = false end
	e.hb.Visible = false
	e.hf.Visible = false
	if e.d then e.d.Visible = false end
end

local function drop(model)
	local e = entries[model]
	if not e then return end
	entries[model] = nil
	highlight(model, false)
	for _, l in ipairs(e.b) do pcall(function() l:Remove() end) end
	pcall(function() e.hb:Remove() end)
	pcall(function() e.hf:Remove() end)
	if e.d then pcall(function() e.d:Remove() end) end
end

local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
	if v < lo then return lo end
	if v > hi then return hi end
	return v
end

local function render(model)
	local h = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if h and h.Health <= 0 then
		local e = entries[model]
		if e then hide(e) end
		return
	end

	local okb, cf, sz = pcall(model.GetBoundingBox, model)
	if not okb or not cf or not sz then return end
	if (cf.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > 2000 then
		local e = entries[model]
		if e then hide(e) end
		return
	end

	local vp = cam.ViewportSize
	local x0, y0, x1, y1
	local vis = true

	for xi = -0.5, 0.5, 1 do
		for yi = -0.5, 0.5, 1 do
			for zi = -0.5, 0.5, 1 do
				local w = cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(sz.X * xi, sz.Y * yi, sz.Z * zi))
				local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(w)
				if on then
					x0 = math.min(x0 or sp.X, sp.X)
					x1 = math.max(x1 or sp.X, sp.X)
					y0 = math.min(y0 or sp.Y, sp.Y)
					y1 = math.max(y1 or sp.Y, sp.Y)
				elseif sp.Z > 0 then
					x0 = math.min(x0 or sp.X, clamp(sp.X, 0, vp.X))
					x1 = math.max(x1 or sp.X, clamp(sp.X, 0, vp.X))
					y0 = math.min(y0 or sp.Y, clamp(sp.Y, 0, vp.Y))
					y1 = math.max(y1 or sp.Y, clamp(sp.Y, 0, vp.Y))
				else
					vis = false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if not vis or not x0 then
		local e = entries[model]
		if e then hide(e) end
		return
	end

	x0 = clamp(x0 - 2, 0, vp.X)
	x1 = clamp(x1 + 2, 0, vp.X)
	y0 = clamp(y0 - 2, 0, vp.Y)
	y1 = clamp(y1 + 2, 0, vp.Y)

	local w = x1 - x0
	local hh = y1 - y0
	if w < 2 or hh < 3 then return end

	local e = entry(model)
	local seg = math.min(w, hh) * 0.22

	local pts = {
		{Vector2.new(x0, y0), Vector2.new(x0 + seg, y0)},
		{Vector2.new(x0, y0), Vector2.new(x0, y0 + seg)},
		{Vector2.new(x1, y0), Vector2.new(x1 - seg, y0)},
		{Vector2.new(x1, y0), Vector2.new(x1, y0 + seg)},
		{Vector2.new(x1, y1), Vector2.new(x1 - seg, y1)},
		{Vector2.new(x1, y1), Vector2.new(x1, y1 - seg)},
		{Vector2.new(x0, y1), Vector2.new(x0 + seg, y1)},
		{Vector2.new(x0, y1), Vector2.new(x0, y1 - seg)},
	}
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local l = e.b[i]
		l.From = pts[i][1]
		l.To = pts[i][2]
		l.Color = S.BoxColor
		l.Visible = true
	end

	if S.Health and h then
		local frac = math.clamp(h.Health / math.max(h.MaxHealth, 1), 0, 1)
		local bx = x0 - 6
		e.hb.Visible = true
		e.hb.From = Vector2.new(bx, y0)
		e.hb.To = Vector2.new(bx, y1)
		e.hf.Visible = frac > 0.01
		e.hf.From = Vector2.new(bx, y1 - hh * frac)
		e.hf.To = Vector2.new(bx, y1)
		e.hf.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 55):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(70, 255, 130), frac)
	else
		e.hb.Visible = false
		e.hf.Visible = false
	end

	if e.d then
		if S.Dist then
			local dist = math.floor((cf.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude + 0.5)
			e.d.Text = tostring(dist) .. "m"
			e.d.Position = Vector2.new((x0 + x1) * 0.5, y1 + 4)
			e.d.Visible = true
		else
			e.d.Visible = false
		end
	end

	highlight(model, true)
end

Run.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end
	local vp = cam.ViewportSize

	for i = #tracers, 1, -1 do
		local t = tracers[i]
		local age = os.clock() - t.t
		if age > 0.42 then
			pcall(function() t.l:Remove() end)
			table.remove(tracers, i)
		else
			local sp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(t.p)
			t.l.Visible = on
			if on then
				t.l.From = Vector2.new(vp.X * 0.5, vp.Y - 24)
				t.l.To = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
				t.l.Transparency = 1 - age / 0.42
			end
		end
	end

	local live = {}

	for _, p in ipairs(Plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local c = p.Character
		if p ~= LP and c and c:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
			and c:GetAttribute("CurrentHighlight") ~= "SpawnProtection" then
			live[c] = true
			render(c)
		end
	end

	if not bots or not bots.Parent then bots = workspace:FindFirstChild("BotCharacters") end
	if bots then
		for _, m in ipairs(bots:GetChildren()) do
			if m:IsA("Model") and m:IsDescendantOf(workspace)
				and m:GetAttribute("CurrentHighlight") ~= "SpawnProtection" then
				live[m] = true
				render(m)
			end
		end
	end

	if not dummies or not dummies.Parent then
		local sr = workspace:FindFirstChild("Shooting Range")
		dummies = sr and sr:FindFirstChild("Dummies") or nil
	end
	if dummies then
		for _, m in ipairs(dummies:GetChildren()) do
			if m:IsA("Model") then
				live[m] = true
				render(m)
			end
		end
	end

	for model, e in pairs(entries) do
		if not live[model] then
			if model.Parent then
				hide(e)
				highlight(model, false)
			else
				drop(model)
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function watch(p)
	if p == LP then return end
	p.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function(c)
		task.wait(0.2)
		drop(c)
	end)
end

for _, p in ipairs(Plrs:GetPlayers()) do watch(p) end
Plrs.PlayerAdded:Connect(watch)
Plrs.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
	if p.Character then drop(p.Character) end
end)
